prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. New bitmap botanical plate for an educational hemp game, using the supplied botanical illustration ONLY as a reference for ink-and-watercolour botanical drawing style on pale cream paper. Do not reproduce its individual specimens.
Create ONE clean horizontal illustrated plate, four independent equally sized vignettes from left to right, ample clear gaps, all entirely Cannabis sativa / industrial hemp, scientifically careful morphology, no other plants, no decorative flowers. No text, labels, letters, arrows, numbered circles or border. Labels and interactivity added in HTML.
Vignette1: a single intact mottled brown hemp achene, oval, subtly pointed, magnified to be readily visible; not a cutaway.
Vignette2: an early germinating hemp achene with shell still attached and ONE curved ivory radicle emerging downward; no second root originating separately, no leaves at this stage.
Vignette3: young hemp seedling with EXACTLY TWO opposite smooth oval green cotyledons and above these the first opposite pair of simple serrated true leaves, thin stem and a modest branched root system exposed, no flower.
Vignette4: a vegetative young hemp plant with a thin upright branching green stem, roots exposed, leaves with recognizable narrow serrated palmate leaflets radiating from one petiole, 5 to7 leaflets on mature leaves. No flowering inflorescences, no fruit or seed forming on this vegetative plant, no colourful flowers.
Not a chronological full reproductive cycle, not a proportional size chart: four separate developmental observations at different magnifications. Match existing botanical reference's careful linework, restrained green and warm ochre, readable small forms, quiet paper, high quality hand-painted textbook illustration. Flat frontal views, ample negative space. Wide landscape composition, four equal columns. Entire images within their own column, no overlap or cut off roots.
review: Quatre observations distinctes : akène intact, radicule émergente, plantule avec deux cotylédons et première paire de feuilles simples dentées, plante végétative à feuilles palmées. Aucune fleur d’une autre espèce. Les silhouettes ne sont pas à une échelle commune.
limits: Illustration synthétique pédagogique, pas photographie ni observation diagnostique. Quatre vignettes ne représentent pas le cycle reproducteur complet. Aucun rendement, durée, consigne ou mesure déduits du dessin.
